scope: All 140 accepted full-paper Jev claims whose candidate.source_unit is not RESULTS; unfocused extraction includes valid methods and background claims.

verdict_policy.complete_supported: Atomic subject–relation–object, polarity, modality, condition and attribution are supported by the source.
verdict_policy.incomplete_or_wrong_qualifier: Core relation is plausible but material setting, direction, hedge, comparison, or cited-prior attribution is omitted or wrong.
verdict_policy.wrong_boundary_or_relation: Actor, predicate, or target is malformed, conflated, or materially wrong.
verdict_policy.unsupported: No defensible claim in source supports the emitted proposition.
verdict_policy.source_ambiguous: Source wording is contradictory or leaves the proposition unresolved.
verdict_policy.unsupported_critical: True when a wrong/unsupported biomedical or clinical relation could materially mislead a graph consumer.
